title: cocode.ask (event)
description: A question with the code. Sent by Ask (Ctrl+K), by Enter on a line that starts with ?? (source "inline", question = the line without the ??), or by a question picked from Doto's menu. Answer in chat; the ?? line stays in the document.

truncated.description: true when text was longer than 64 000 characters; the tail is kept.

selection.description: The selected range the question is about, when there is one.

rev.description: Document revision; starts at 1 and never goes down.

lang.description: Free text, 1-24 characters: python, js, my-lang, pseudo.

line.description: 1-based line the question is about (the caret line, or the ?? line).

col.description: 0-based column, in characters of the line.
